First alpha. Expect rough edges, and please report bugs.

## What works
- **Login:** school search, username/password with two-factor codes, QR code login, demo mode.
- **Multiple accounts**, also across schools, with a quick switcher.
- **Week timetable** with substitutions, cancellations and exams; offline cache; pull to refresh.
- **Teachers are shown** even when the school leaves them out of the mobile API (taken from the newer REST timetable).
- **Day view:** tap a day to zoom in, tap the date to go back.
- **Browse timetables:** classes, rooms and teachers. Room and teacher timetables are rebuilt from class timetables when your account can't open them directly.
- **Lesson colours** (presets, hue, hex code), text size, bold and centred text, hide cancelled lessons.
- **Debug view** of raw server responses, for bug reports. It contains personal data, so remove names before sharing.

## Not yet
Info center (messages, homework, exams, absences), free rooms, notifications, widgets, German translation.

## Install

**Android:** download the `.apk` and open it (allow installing from unknown sources if asked).

**iPhone / iPad:** the `.ipa` is unsigned. Sideload it with [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) using your Apple ID. With a free Apple ID, the app must be re-signed every 7 days.
